title: dithyrea californica var. maritima
intro: Dithyrea californica var. maritima, commonly known as California brussels or coastal range brussels, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which can help in soothing and protecting the skin, and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Dithyrea californica var. maritima include isothiocyanates, which are known for their antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
